title: Mall World Toilets
content: Last night I had such a vivid dream- I was with my close friend looking to use a bathroom, however the bathroom stalls were connected to other bathroom stalls. You could close the door, but it doesn’t give you any privacy. This toilet in particular was clean as I entered the area and called out to my friend keeping watch, “hey these are just like the bathrooms in mall world, don’t let someone walk in on me while I pee.” I genuinely thought I was in my waking life, but turns out it was just a dream.
